analysis.ambiguity1:
Requirement: A feature to “drag and drop courses into the calendar” and a “warning when selecting a class at 8:00 AM”.

Why it's ambiguous: This requirement is confusing the scope between "4-Year Study Pathway" (managing the model by semester) and "Managing the model by time" (managing the model by day/hour). Additionally, the 8:00 AM warning is a personal preference of the student; it's unclear whether this is a mandatory system feature (restricting hardcoding) or a personal setting option (customizable user settings).
